data.body:
Closed as superseded with an operator-authorized force on 2026-10-30.

Why force was needed, and why that is a defect rather than policy: the plan-review close gate has a designed non-force path for administrative closes (`_disposition_close_exempt`, gates.py:184 on origin/main 38f8587f65d), but for `superseded` the only evidence it accepts is a replacement link — `superseded` is absent from `REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES`, so `--reason` cannot satisfy it. Every way to write that link here is blocked:

- The three slices that absorbed this story's scope (43bd-2668-aa3e-4950, f7bd-e80c, 742d-3980) are all closed, and `_links.py:260` refuses a closed source for every relation.
- The parent epic 87d8 is refused as a redundant ancestor-descendant link.
- There is no reciprocal `superseded_by` relation, and only `relates_to` writes a reciprocal, so this ticket cannot record the relationship from its own side.
- The one writable shape, an outbound `duplicates` link to a single slice, would misstate a three-way decomposition.

Filed as bug 868c-dd56-d464-44bf (unpaid-sanctified-aardvark), linked discovered_from this ticket.

Closing it released f5f5-51cd-0a9f-4127, which had a `depends_on` edge on this ticket.
